name: the Meridian mobile app
label: Mobile app

modes.title: App closing on launch
modes.symptom: the app closing immediately after it is opened
customer_says: The Meridian app crashes the moment I open it. I see the logo and then I'm back on my home screen.
Your app won't stay open. It flashes up and shuts down straight away.
I can't use the app at all. It closes itself as soon as it starts.
The app keeps quitting on launch. I've reinstalled it and it still does it.

causes.cause: a faulty remote configuration flag for the new home screen
fixes: turning off the faulty remote configuration flag

causes.cause: a malformed promotional banner that the app could not display
an app release built with a broken analytics library

workarounds: open the account in a phone browser at the portal address
switch the phone to flight mode, open the app, then turn flight mode off
aftercare: update the app from the app store
open the app once while connected so it fetches fresh settings

modes.title: Usage figures out of date
modes.symptom: usage figures frozen at an old reading
customer_says: The app is showing the wrong data usage. The figure just isn't moving.
My allowance in the app is stuck. It says I've used nothing, and I've been streaming videos.
The usage screen won't update. I can't tell how much data I have left.
The minutes and data shown in the app are clearly out of date.

causes.cause: a usage records feed that stopped at the mediation system
a reporting database replica that fell hours behind
a batch job that failed on a bad record and halted
fixes: rerunning the halted batch job past the bad record

workarounds: dial the free balance code from the phone's keypad for a live figure
text the word USAGE to the short number printed on the bill
aftercare: pull down on the usage screen to refresh the figures
allow a few hours for older usage to appear in full

modes.title: Repeated notifications
modes.symptom: the same notification being sent again and again
customer_says: The app keeps pinging me with the same bill reminder. I've had about thirty.
My phone won't stop buzzing with identical notifications from the Meridian app.
I'm getting your bill is ready over and over from the app, every few minutes.
The app is spamming me with the same alert. I've had to mute my phone.

causes.cause: a notification campaign stuck in a retry loop
a delivery receipt service that stopped confirming sent alerts
a scheduler that started the same send job twice a minute
fixes: removing the duplicated send job from the scheduler

workarounds: mute notifications for the app in the phone's settings
sign out of the app until the repeated alerts stop
aftercare: turn the app's notifications back on
ignore any duplicate reminders that are still waiting on the phone

modes.title: Fingerprint and face sign-in failing
modes.symptom: fingerprint and face sign-in being rejected by the app
customer_says: The app won't accept my fingerprint any more. It makes me type the password, and then fails as well.
Face unlock has stopped working in the Meridian app. It just says cannot verify.
I can't get into the app with my fingerprint. It worked fine before.
The app keeps refusing my face login and asking me to set it up again.

causes.cause: a device trust service that rejected every stored key
fixes: restoring the key database of the device trust service

causes.cause: an expired signing certificate in the app's sign-in service
fixes: renewing the signing certificate in the app's sign-in service

causes.cause: a security policy update that cancelled all remembered devices

workarounds: sign in with the password and the one-time code sent by text
use the portal in a browser, which does not rely on device sign-in
aftercare: turn fingerprint or face sign-in on again in the app's security settings
sign in once with the password to register the phone again

wrong_customer_side: a phone that is short of storage space
an operating system too old for the app
battery saver mode restricting the app
a corrupted download of the app
wrong_provider_side: a new version of the app still rolling out
a scheduled refresh of customer accounts
a phone maker's update that broke several apps
